intro.en: Here are eight short funny stories (nawadir and turaf) about Hisham and his wife, the uninvited guest Marwan, the poet Hashim, a stingy father, a hunter, and Juha. Read slowly and enjoy each story.
intro.ur: Yahan aath chhote mazahiya qisse (nawadir aur turaf) hain: Hisham aur us ki biwi, tufaili Marwan, shayar Hashim, kanjoos baap, ek shikari aur Juha ke baare mein. Aahista parhein aur har qisse ka maza lein.
intro.ar: ثَمانِي حِكاياتٍ ظَريفَةٍ قَصيرَةٍ (نَوادِرُ وَطُرَفٌ) عَنْ هِشامٍ وَزَوْجَتِهِ، وَالطُّفَيْلِيِّ مَرْوانَ، وَالشّاعِرِ هاشِمٍ، وَأَبٍ بَخيلٍ، وَصَيّادٍ، وَجُحا. اِقْرَأْ بِبُطْءٍ وَاسْتَمْتِعْ بِكُلِّ حِكايَةٍ.

dialogue.ar: كانَتْ نَوالُ جَميلَةً جِدّاً، وَكانَ زَوْجُها هِشامٌ قَبيحَ الوَجْهِ، لَكِنَّهُ طَيِّبُ القَلْبِ وَخَفيفُ الظِّلِّ.
dialogue.tr: kānat naūālu jamīlatan jiddan, wakāna zawjuhā hishāmun qabīḥa l-wajh, lākinnahu ṭayyibu l-qalbi wakhafīfu ẓ-ẓilli.
dialogue.en: Nawal was very beautiful, and her husband Hisham was ugly in the face, but he was kind-hearted and good-humoured.
dialogue.ur: Nawal bohat khoobsurat thi aur us ka shohar Hisham shakal ka badsoorat tha, lekin woh narm dil aur khush mizaj tha.

dialogue.ar: وُلِدَتْ لَهُما بِنْتٌ تُشْبِهُ أُمَّها، فَقالَ هِشامٌ: الحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذي جَعَلَها تُشْبِهُكِ! فَقالَتْ نَوالُ: وَأَنا أَحْمَدُهُ لِأَنَّها أَخَذَتْ مِنْكَ قَلْبَكَ الطَّيِّبَ.
dialogue.tr: wulidat lahumā bintun tushbihu ummahā, faqāla hishāmun: al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī jaʿalahā tushbihuk! fa-qālat naūāl: waʾanā aḥmaduhu liʾannahā akhadhat minka qalbaka ṭ-ṭayyib.
dialogue.en: They had a daughter who looked like her mother. Hisham said: Praise be to Allah who made her look like you! Nawal said: And I praise Him because she took your kind heart.
dialogue.ur: Un ke ghar beti hui jo apni maan jaisi thi. Hisham bola: Allah ka shukr jis ne use tum jaisa banaya! Nawal boli: Aur main is liye shukr karti hoon ke us ne tumhara achha dil liya.

dialogue.ar: سَمِعَ طُفَيْلِيٌّ يُدْعى مَرْوانُ بِوَليمَةِ عُرْسٍ في الحَيِّ، فَلَبِسَ أَحْسَنَ ثِيابِهِ وَدَخَلَ القاعَةَ بِلا دَعْوَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: samiʿa ṭufayliyyun yudʿā marūānu biwalīmati ʿursin fī l-ḥayyi, falabisa aḥsana thīābihi wadakhala l-qāʿata bilā daʿwatin.
dialogue.en: An uninvited guest called Marwan heard of a wedding feast in the neighbourhood, so he put on his best clothes and entered the hall without an invitation.
dialogue.ur: Marwan naam ke ek tufaili ne mohalle mein shaadi ki daawat ka suna, to us ne behtareen kapde pehne aur bina bulaye hall mein ghus gaya.

dialogue.ar: جَلَسَ أَمامَ القَصْعَةِ الكَبيرَةِ، فَسَأَلَهُ أَهْلُ العَريسِ: هَلْ أَنْتَ مِنْ أَقارِبِ العَروسِ؟ فَقالَ: نَعَمْ! وَسَأَلَهُ أَهْلُ العَروسِ: هَلْ أَنْتَ مِنْ أَقارِبِ العَريسِ؟ فَقالَ: طَبْعاً!
dialogue.tr: jalasa amāma l-qaṣʿati l-kabīrati, fasaʾalahu ahlu l-ʿarīs: hal anta min aqāribi l-ʿarūs? faqāl: naʿam! wasaʾalahu ahlu l-ʿarūs: hal anta min aqāribi l-ʿarīs? faqāl: ṭabʿan!
dialogue.en: He sat in front of the big bowl. The groom's family asked: Are you one of the bride's relatives? He said: Yes! The bride's family asked: Are you one of the groom's relatives? He said: Of course!
dialogue.ur: Woh bare bartan (qas'a) ke saamne baith gaya. Dulha walon ne poocha: Kya aap dulhan ke rishtedaar hain? Bola: Haan! Dulhan walon ne poocha: Kya aap dulhe ke rishtedaar hain? Bola: Zaroor!

dialogue.ar: وَلَمّا اجْتَمَعَ الفَريقانِ عِنْدَهُ قالَ: أَنا ضَيْفُ الجُوعِ، دَعاني بَطْني فَلَبَّيْتُ! فَضَحِكوا جَميعاً وَقَدَّموا لَهُ طَبَقاً آخَرَ.
dialogue.tr: walammā jtamaʿa l-farīqāni ʿindahu qāl: anā ḍayfu l-jūʿ, daʿānī baṭnī falabbayt! faḍaḥikū jamīʿan waqaddamū lahu ṭabaqan ʾākhar.
dialogue.en: When both sides gathered around him he said: I am the guest of hunger; my stomach invited me and I answered! They all laughed and gave him another plate.
dialogue.ur: Jab dono taraf ke log us ke paas jama hue to bola: Main bhook ka mehman hoon, mere pait ne bulaya aur main aa gaya! Sab hans pade aur use aik aur plate de di.

dialogue.ar: أَنْشَدَ الشّاعِرُ هاشِمٌ قَصيدَةً طَويلَةً أَمامَ الوالي، فَأُعْجِبَ بِها وَقالَ: اُطْلُبْ ما تَشاءُ.
dialogue.tr: anshada sh-shāʿiru hāshimun qaṣīdatan ṭaūīlatan amāma l-wālī, faʾuʿjiba bihā waqāl: uṭlub mā tashāʾ.
dialogue.en: The poet Hashim recited a long poem before the governor, who liked it and said: Ask for whatever you wish.
dialogue.ur: Shayar Hashim ne gawarnar ke saamne ek lambi nazm sunayi. Use pasand aayi aur kaha: Jo chaho maango.

dialogue.ar: فَقالَ هاشِمٌ: أُريدُ جَواداً أَصيلاً. فَأَمَرَ لَهُ الوالي بِأَجْمَلِ جَوادٍ في الإِسْطَبْلِ.
dialogue.tr: faqāla hāshimun: urīdu jaūādan aṣīlan. faʾamara lahu l-wālī biʾajmali jaūādin fī l-ʾisṭabl.
dialogue.en: Hashim said: I want a thoroughbred horse. So the governor ordered for him the most beautiful horse in the stable.
dialogue.ur: Hashim bola: Mujhe asli nasl ka ghoda chahiye. Gawarnar ne us ke liye astabal ka sab se khoobsurat ghoda dene ka hukm diya.

dialogue.ar: فَقالَ الشّاعِرُ: شُكْراً يا مَوْلايَ، وَالآنَ مَنْ يُعْطيني ثَمَنَ العَلَفِ؟ فَضَحِكَ الوالي وَأَعْطاهُ جائِزَةً أُخْرى.
dialogue.tr: faqāla sh-shāʿir: shukran yā mawlāy, wa-l-ʾāna man yuʿṭīnī thamana l-ʿalaf? faḍaḥika l-wālī waʾaʿṭāhu jāʾizatan ukhrā.
dialogue.en: The poet said: Thank you, my lord, and now who will give me the price of the fodder? The governor laughed and gave him another prize.
dialogue.ur: Shayar bola: Shukriya huzoor, ab chaare ki qeemat kaun dega? Gawarnar hans pada aur use aik aur inaam diya.

dialogue.ar: كانَ زاهِرٌ بَخيلاً، وَكانَ ابْنُهُ يَأْكُلُ العَسَلَ سِرّاً، فَكَتَبَ عَلى الإِناءِ: سُمٌّ قاتِلٌ!
dialogue.tr: kāna zāhirun bakhīlan, wakāna bnuhu yaʾkulu l-ʿasala sirran, fakataba ʿalā l-ʾināʾ: summun qātilun!
dialogue.en: Zahir was stingy, and his son used to eat the honey secretly, so he wrote on the jar: Deadly poison!
dialogue.ur: Zahir kanjoos tha aur us ka beta chupke se shahad khata tha, to us ne bartan par likh diya: Jaan leva zehar!

dialogue.ar: وَفي الصَّباحِ وَجَدَ الإِناءَ فارِغاً وَتَحْتَهُ وَرَقَةٌ: أَكَلْتُ مِنْ هذا السُّمِّ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ يا أَبي، وَما زِلْتُ حَيّاً!
dialogue.tr: wafī ṣ-ṣabāḥi wajada l-ʾināʾa fārighan wataḥtahu waraqatun: akaltu min hādhā s-summi kulla yawmin yā abī, wamā ziltu ḥayyan!
dialogue.en: In the morning he found the jar empty and a note under it: I ate this poison every day, Father, and I am still alive!
dialogue.ur: Subah us ne bartan khali paya aur neeche parcha tha: Abbu, main roz yeh zehar khata raha aur abhi tak zindah hoon!

dialogue.ar: قالَ صَيّادٌ لِصَديقِهِ: اِشْتَرَيْتُ كَلْبَ صَيْدٍ لا يُخْطِئُ أَبَداً!
dialogue.tr: qāla ṣayyādun liṣadīqih: ishtaraytu kalba ṣaydin lā yukhṭiʾu abadan!
dialogue.en: A hunter said to his friend: I bought a hunting dog that never misses!
dialogue.ur: Ek shikari ne dost se kaha: Maine shikari kutta khareeda hai jo kabhi khata nahin karta!

dialogue.ar: فَسَأَلَهُ صَديقُهُ: وَكَمْ أَرْنَباً أَمْسَكَ؟ قالَ: وَلا أَرْنَباً، لَكِنَّهُ لا يُخْطِئُ في النُّباحِ!
dialogue.tr: fasaʾalahu ṣadīquh: wakam arnaban amsak? qāl: walā arnaban, lākinnahu lā yukhṭiʾu fī n-nubāḥ!
dialogue.en: His friend asked: And how many rabbits has he caught? He said: Not one, but he never misses when barking!
dialogue.ur: Dost ne poocha: Aur ab tak kitne khargosh pakde? Bola: Ek bhi nahin, lekin woh bhonkne mein kabhi khata nahin karta!

dialogue.ar: حَفَرَ جُحا حُفْرَةً كَبيرَةً في فِناءِ بَيْتِهِ، فَسَأَلَهُ جارُهُ: لِماذا تَحْفِرُ؟
dialogue.tr: ḥafara juḥā ḥufratan kabīratan fī fināʾi baytih, fasaʾalahu jāruh: limādhā taḥfir?
dialogue.en: Juha dug a big hole in the yard of his house, and his neighbour asked him: Why are you digging?
dialogue.ur: Juha ne apne ghar ke sehn mein bara gaddha khoda to padosi ne poocha: Tum kyun khod rahe ho?

dialogue.ar: قالَ: أَدْفِنُ فيها التُّرابَ الَّذي أَخْرَجْتُهُ مِنْ حُفْرَةٍ أُخْرى! قالَ الجارُ: وَأَيْنَ تَضَعُ تُرابَ هذِهِ؟ قالَ جُحا: سَأَحْفِرُ حُفْرَةً ثالِثَةً!
dialogue.tr: qāl: adfinu fīhā t-turāba alladhī akhrajtuhu min ḥufratin ukhrā! qāla l-jār: waʾayna taḍaʿu turāba hādhih? qāla juḥā: saʾaḥfiru ḥufratan thālithatan!
dialogue.en: He said: I am burying in it the soil I took out of another hole! The neighbour said: And where will you put the soil of this one? Juha said: I will dig a third hole!
dialogue.ur: Bola: Main is mein woh mitti dafan kar raha hoon jo doosre gaddhe se nikali thi! Padosi bola: Aur is gaddhe ki mitti kahan rakhoge? Juha bola: Main teesra gaddha khodunga!

dialogue.ar: قالَ جُحا لِزَوْجَتِهِ: إِذا رَأَيْتِ سَحابَةً سَوْداءَ فَلا تَنْشُري الغَسيلَ.
dialogue.tr: qāla juḥā lizawjatih: idhā raʾayti saḥābatan sawdāʾa falā tanshurī l-ghasīl.
dialogue.en: Juha said to his wife: If you see a black cloud, do not hang out the washing.
dialogue.ur: Juha ne biwi se kaha: Agar kaali badli dekho to kapde sukhane ke liye mat daalna.

dialogue.ar: فَنَظَرَتْ فَرَأَتْ سَحابَةً بَيْضاءَ، فَنَشَرَتْ، فَأَمْطَرَتِ السَّماءُ! قالَ: السَّوْداءُ في الطَّريقِ، وَلَمْ أُخْبِرْكِ أَنَّ البَيْضاءَ تَسْبِقُها!
dialogue.tr: fanaẓarat faraʾat saḥābatan bayḍāʾ, fanasharat, faʾamṭarati s-samāʾ! qāl: as-sawdāʾu fī ṭ-ṭarīq, walam ukhbirki anna l-bayḍāʾa tasbiquhā!
dialogue.en: She looked and saw a white cloud, so she hung it out, and the sky rained! He said: The black one is on the way, and I did not tell you that the white one goes before it!
dialogue.ur: Us ne dekha to safed badli thi, us ne kapde daal diye aur baarish ho gayi! Bola: Kaali badli raaste mein hai, aur maine tumhein nahin bataya ke safed us se pehle aati hai!

dialogue.ar: ضاعَ حِمارُ جُحا، فَخَرَجَ يَبْحَثُ عَنْهُ وَهُوَ يَقولُ: الحَمْدُ للهِ! فَسَأَلَهُ النّاسُ: لِماذا تَحْمَدُ اللهَ وَقَدْ ضاعَ حِمارُكَ؟
dialogue.tr: ḍāʿa ḥimāru juḥā, fakharaja yabḥathu ʿanhu wahuwa yaqūl: al-ḥamdu li-llā! fasaʾalahu n-nās: limādhā taḥmadu Allāh waqad ḍāʿa ḥimāruk?
dialogue.en: Juha's donkey was lost, so he went out looking for it saying: Praise be to Allah! People asked him: Why do you praise Allah when your donkey is lost?
dialogue.ur: Juha ka gadha kho gaya, woh dhoondne nikla aur kehta gaya: Allah ka shukr hai! Logon ne poocha: Gadha kho gaya aur tum shukr kyun kar rahe ho?

dialogue.ar: قالَ: لِأَنِّي لَمْ أَكُنْ راكِباً عَلَيْهِ، وَإِلّا ضِعْتُ مَعَهُ!
dialogue.tr: qāl: liʾannī lam akun rākiban ʿalayh, waʾillā ḍiʿtu maʿah!
dialogue.en: He said: Because I was not riding it, otherwise I would have been lost with it!
dialogue.ur: Bola: Is liye ke main us par sawar nahin tha, warna main bhi us ke saath kho jata!

q.en: Why did Nawal praise Allah when their daughter was born?
q.ur: Beti ki paidaish par Nawal ne Allah ki hamd kyun ki?
q.ar: لِماذا حَمِدَتْ نَوالُ اللهَ عِنْدَ وِلادَةِ ابْنَتِهِما؟

options: The girl took her father's kind heart
options_ar: لِأَنَّ البِنْتَ أَخَذَتْ قَلْبَ أَبيها الطَّيِّبَ

q.ur: «طُفَيْلِيٌّ» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: What did the poet Hashim ask the governor for?
q.ur: Shayar Hashim ne gawarnar se kya manga?
q.ar: ماذا طَلَبَ الشّاعِرُ هاشِمٌ مِنَ الوالي؟

q.en: What did Juha say he was burying in the hole?
q.ur: Juha ne kaha ke woh gaddhe mein kya dafan kar raha hai?
q.ar: ماذا قالَ جُحا إِنَّهُ يَدْفِنُ في الحُفْرَةِ؟

options_ar: التُّرابَ الَّذي أَخْرَجَهُ مِنْ حُفْرَةٍ أُخْرى

q.en: What did Zahir write on the honey jar?
q.ur: Zahir ne shahad ke bartan par kya likha?
q.ar: ماذا كَتَبَ زاهِرٌ عَلى إِناءِ العَسَلِ؟

intro.en: After reading, you check your understanding. Mark each sentence true or false and fix the mistake, match titles to paragraphs, then learn the meanings of new words from their definitions.
intro.ur: Parhne ke baad hum apni samajh jaanchte hain. Har jumle ko sahi ya ghalat batayein aur ghalti theek karein, unwan ko hisson se milayein, phir naye alfaz ke matlab seekhein.
intro.ar: بَعْدَ القِراءَةِ تَتَحَقَّقُ مِنْ فَهْمِكَ: تُحَدِّدُ الجُمَلَ الصَّحيحَةَ وَالخاطِئَةَ وَتُصَحِّحُ الخَطَأَ، وَتُطابِقُ العَناوينَ بِالفِقَراتِ، ثُمَّ تَتَعَلَّمُ مَعاني الكَلِماتِ الجَديدَةِ مِنْ تَعْريفاتِها.

dialogue.ar: ضَحِكَ الحاضِرونَ مِنْ جَوابِ الطُّفَيْلِيِّ وَأَعْطَوْهُ طَبَقاً آخَرَ.
dialogue.tr: ḍaḥika l-ḥāḍirūna min jaūābi ṭ-ṭufayliyyi waʾaʿṭawhu ṭabaqan ʾākhar.
dialogue.en: The guests laughed at the uninvited guest's answer and gave him another plate. (Correct)
dialogue.ur: Mehmanon ne tufaili ke jawab par hans kar use aik aur plate di. (Durust)

dialogue.ar: كَتَبَ الأَبُ كَلِمَةَ «سُمٌّ» عَلى إِناءِ العَسَلِ.
dialogue.tr: kataba l-ʾabu kalimata summun ʿalā ināʾi l-ʿasal.
dialogue.en: The father wrote the word "poison" on the honey jar. (Correct)
dialogue.ur: Baap ne shahad ke bartan par lafz "zehar" likha. (Durust)

dialogue.ar: طَلَبَ الشّاعِرُ هاشِمٌ كَلْبَ صَيْدٍ مِنَ الوالي.
dialogue.tr: ṭalaba sh-shāʿiru hāshimun kalba ṣaydin mina l-wālī.
dialogue.en: The poet Hashim asked the governor for a hunting dog. (Wrong: he asked for a horse.)
dialogue.ur: Shayar Hashim ne gawarnar se shikari kutta manga. (Ghalat: us ne ghoda manga tha.)

dialogue.ar: حَفَرَ جُحا الحُفْرَةَ لِيَزْرَعَ فيها شَجَرَةً.
dialogue.tr: ḥafara juḥā l-ḥufrata liyazraʿa fīhā shajaratan.
dialogue.en: Juha dug the hole to plant a tree in it. (Wrong: to bury the soil of another hole.)
dialogue.ur: Juha ne gaddha is liye khoda ke us mein darakht lagaye. (Ghalat: doosre gaddhe ki mitti dafan karne ke liye.)

q.en: Which word means «a place where things are bought and sold»?
q.ur: «Jahan cheezein khareedi aur bechi jaati hain» kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني «مَكانًا يُبْتاعُ فيهِ الأَشْياءُ وَتُباعُ»؟

q.en: Which word means «a person who works serving in homes»?
q.ur: «Gharon mein khidmat karne wala shakhs» kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني «شَخْصًا يَعْمَلُ في خِدْمَةِ البُيوتِ»؟

q.ur: «صَحْراءُ» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which is the organ of the body used to see?
q.ur: Jism ka kaun sa hissa dekhne ke liye hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني عُضْوَ الجِسْمِ الَّذي نُبْصِرُ بِهِ؟

q.ur: «أُسْرَةٌ» kya hai?

intro.en: A badal is a word that comes right after another word and explains it, taking the same case ending. Example: «سَلَّمْتُ عَلى صَديقي خالِدٍ» – 'Khalid' names 'my friend'. There are three kinds: whole for whole, part for whole, and inclusion.
intro.ur: Badal woh lafz hai jo kisi doosre lafz ke foran baad aa kar us ki wazahat karta hai aur usi ka i'rab leta hai. Misal: «سَلَّمْتُ عَلى صَديقي خالِدٍ» – "Khalid" batata hai ke "mera dost" kaun hai. Is ki teen qismein hain: badal-e-kul, badal-e-baz aur badal-e-ishtimal.
intro.ar: البَدَلُ تابِعٌ يَأْتي بَعْدَ كَلِمَةٍ وَيُوَضِّحُها، وَيَتْبَعُها في الإِعْرابِ. مِثالٌ: «سَلَّمْتُ عَلى صَديقي خالِدٍ»؛ «خالِدٍ» يُبَيِّنُ مَنْ هُوَ «صَديقي». وَأَنْواعُهُ ثَلاثَةٌ: بَدَلُ كُلٍّ مِنْ كُلٍّ، وَبَدَلُ بَعْضٍ مِنْ كُلٍّ، وَبَدَلُ اشْتِمالٍ.

dialogue.ar: سَلَّمْتُ عَلى صَديقي خالِدٍ في السّوقِ.
dialogue.tr: sallamtu ʿalā ṣadīqī khālidin fī s-sūq.
dialogue.en: I greeted my friend Khalid in the market. (whole for whole)
dialogue.ur: Maine bazaar mein apne dost Khalid ko salam kiya. (kul ka kul)

dialogue.ar: حَفِظْتُ القَصيدَةَ ثُلُثَها.
dialogue.tr: ḥafiẓtu l-qaṣīdata thuluthahā.
dialogue.en: I memorised the poem, a third of it. (part for whole)
dialogue.ur: Maine nazm ka teesra hissa yaad kiya. (kul ka juz)

dialogue.ar: أَدْهَشَني الطِّفْلُ ذَكاؤُهُ.
dialogue.tr: adhashanī ṭ-ṭiflu dhakāʾuh.
dialogue.en: The child amazed me, his intelligence. (inclusion)
dialogue.ur: Bachche ne mujhe hairan kiya, us ki zaheen-pan se. (ishtimal)

dialogue.ar: يَنْفَعُني الأُسْتاذُ عِلْمُهُ.
dialogue.tr: yanfaʿunī l-ʾustādhu ʿilmuh.
dialogue.en: The teacher benefits me, his knowledge.
dialogue.ur: Ustaad mujhe faida deta hai, us ka ilm.

q.ur: Badal kya hai?

options: A word that follows another and clarifies it

q.en: In «سَلَّمْتُ عَلى صَديقي خالِدٍ» which word is the badal?
q.ur: «سَلَّمْتُ عَلى صَديقي خالِدٍ» mein badal kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: في «سَلَّمْتُ عَلى صَديقي خالِدٍ»، أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ هِيَ البَدَلُ؟

q.en: In «حَفِظْتُ القَصيدَةَ ثُلُثَها» the badal is:
q.ur: «حَفِظْتُ القَصيدَةَ ثُلُثَها» mein badal kaun sa hai?

q.en: «أَدْهَشَني الطِّفْلُ ذَكاؤُهُ» is which kind of badal?
q.ur: «أَدْهَشَني الطِّفْلُ ذَكاؤُهُ» badal ki kaun si qism hai?
q.ar: «أَدْهَشَني الطِّفْلُ ذَكاؤُهُ» أَيُّ أَنْواعِ البَدَلِ هذا؟

q.ur: «نِصْفٌ» ka matlab kya hai?

title.ur: Sun kar samajhna: Juha aur chor

intro.en: Listen to the story of Juha in two parts, then put the events in order and answer questions. In the story, tired Juha wakes in the dark, sees a big shape in the garden, fears it is a thief and picks up a stick. In the morning he finds it was only the shadow of a tree!
intro.ur: Juha ki kahani do hisson mein suniye, phir waqiat ki tarteeb banayen aur sawalat ke jawab den. Kahani mein thaka hua Juha andhere mein jaagta hai, baghiche mein bara saaya dekh kar chor ka khauf karta hai aur daanda utha leta hai. Subah pata chalta hai ke woh to sirf ek darakht ka saaya tha!
intro.ar: تَسْتَمِعُ إِلى حِكايَةِ جُحا في جُزْأَيْنِ، ثُمَّ تُرَتِّبُ الأَحْداثَ وَتُجيبُ. في الحِكايَةِ يَسْتَيْقِظُ جُحا المُتْعَبُ في الظَّلامِ، فَيَرى جِسْماً كَبيراً في الحَديقَةِ وَيَخافُ أَنْ يَكونَ لِصًّا، فَيَلْتَقِطُ عَصاً. وَفي الصَّباحِ يَجِدُهُ ظِلَّ شَجَرَةٍ!

dialogue.ar: يَعودُ جُحا مِنَ المَزْرَعَةِ في شِدَّةِ التَّعَبِ، فَيَتَناوَلُ الغَداءَ وَيَسْتَسْلِمُ لِلنَّوْمِ.
dialogue.tr: yaʿūdu juḥā mina l-mazraʿati fī shiddati t-taʿab, fayatanāwalu l-ghadāʾa wayastaslimu lilnnawm.
dialogue.en: Juha comes back from the farm in great tiredness, eats lunch and gives in to sleep.
dialogue.ur: Juha khet se bohat thaka hua lautta hai, dopehar ka khana khata hai aur so jata hai.

dialogue.ar: تَتَعَجَّبُ زَوْجَتُهُ مِنْ نَوْمِهِ الطَّويلِ وَتَقولُ: أَما زِلْتَ نائِماً؟
dialogue.tr: tataʿajjabu zawjatuhu min nawmihi ṭ-ṭaūīli wataqūl: amā zilta nāʾiman?
dialogue.en: His wife is amazed at his long sleep and says: Are you still asleep?
dialogue.ur: Us ki biwi us ki lambi neend par hairan hoti hai aur kehti hai: Kya aap abhi tak so rahe hain?

dialogue.ar: يَسْتَيْقِظُ جُحا في الظَّلامِ وَيَرى جِسْماً كَبيراً في الحَديقَةِ، فَيَخافُ.
dialogue.tr: yastayqiẓu juḥā fī ẓ-ẓalāmi wayarā jisman kabīran fī l-ḥadīqati, fayakhāf.
dialogue.en: Juha wakes in the dark and sees a big shape in the garden, and he gets scared.
dialogue.ur: Juha andhere mein jaagta hai aur baghiche mein ek bara saaya dekhta hai, to dar jata hai.

dialogue.ar: يَقولُ: لِصٌّ! وَيَلْتَقِطُ عَصاً، لِأَنَّهُ لا يَمْلِكُ رَصاصاً.
dialogue.tr: yaqūl: liṣṣun! wayaltaqiṭu ʿaṣan, liʾannahu lā yamliku raṣāṣan.
dialogue.en: He says: A thief! and picks up a stick, because he has no bullets.
dialogue.ur: Woh kehta hai: Chor! Aur daanda utha leta hai kyunke us ke paas goliyan nahin hain.

dialogue.ar: وَفي الصَّباحِ يَجِدُ أَنَّهُ ظِلُّ شَجَرَةِ الرُّمّانِ، فَيَضْحَكُ وَيَمْلَأُهُ السُّرورُ.
dialogue.tr: wafī ṣ-ṣabāḥi yajidu annahu ẓillu shajarati r-rummān, fayaḍḥaku wayamlaʾuhu s-surūr.
dialogue.en: In the morning he finds it was the shadow of the pomegranate tree, so he laughs and is filled with joy.
dialogue.ur: Subah dekhta hai ke woh anaar ke darakht ka saaya tha, to hanste hue khushi se bhar jata hai.

q.ur: «لِصٌّ» ka matlab kya hai?
«رَصاصٌ» ka matlab kya hai?
«الظَّلامُ» ka matlab kya hai?
«Baagh» ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني أَرْضًا فيها أَشْجارٌ وَأَزْهارٌ بِجانِبِ البَيْتِ؟

q.ur: «اسْتَيْقَظَ» ka matlab kya hai?

intro.en: In this lesson you talk about funny stories (nawadir wa turaf) with a partner: Do you like them? Is there a character like Juha in your culture? Then you retell each story in your own words.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein aap apne saathi ke saath mazahiya qisson (nawadir wa turaf) ke baare mein baat karte hain: Kya aapko pasand hain? Kya aapki saqafat mein Juha jaisa kirdar hai? Phir har qissa apne alfaz mein sunate hain.
intro.ar: تَتَحَدَّثُ مَعَ زَميلٍ عَنِ النَّوادِرِ وَالطُّرَفِ: هَلْ تُحِبُّها؟ هَلْ في ثَقافَتِكَ شَخْصِيَّةٌ مِثْلُ جُحا؟ ثُمَّ تَرْوي كُلَّ حِكايَةٍ بِأُسْلوبِكَ.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ تَضْحَكُ كَثيراً عِنْدَ سَماعِ النَّوادِرِ؟ مَنْ يَرْويها لَكَ؟
dialogue.tr: hal taḍḥaku kathīran ʿinda samāʿi n-naūādir? man yarūīhā lak?
dialogue.en: Do you laugh a lot when you hear funny stories? Who tells them to you?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap latife sun kar bohat hanste hain? Aap ko kaun sunata hai?

dialogue.ar: هَلْ تَعْرِفُ شَخْصِيَّةً ظَريفَةً في لُغَتِكَ تُشْبِهُ جُحا؟ ما اسْمُها؟
dialogue.tr: hal taʿrifu shakhṣiyyatan ẓarīfatan fī lughatika tushbihu juḥā? mā smuhā?
dialogue.en: Do you know a funny character in your language similar to Juha? What is the name?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap ki zaban mein Juha jaisa koi mazahiya kirdar hai? Us ka naam kya hai?

dialogue.ar: هَلْ هَذِهِ الشَّخْصِيّاتُ مَوْجودَةٌ في الحَقيقَةِ أَمْ مِنْ صُنْعِ الخَيالِ؟
dialogue.tr: hal hādhihi sh-shakhṣiyyātu mawjūdatun fī l-ḥaqīqati am min ṣunʿi l-khaīāl?
dialogue.en: Do these characters exist in reality or are they made up by imagination?
dialogue.ur: Kya yeh kirdar haqeeqat mein maujood hain ya khayal ki paidawar hain?

dialogue.ar: اِرْوِ حِكايَةَ الطُّفَيْلِيِّ مَرْوانَ لِزَميلِكَ بِأُسْلوبِكَ.
dialogue.tr: irwi ḥikāyata ṭ-ṭufayliyyi marūāna lizamīlika biʾuslūbik.
dialogue.en: Tell your classmate the story of the uninvited guest Marwan in your own way.
dialogue.ur: Apne sathi ko tufaili Marwan ki kahani apne andaz mein sunayen.

dialogue.ar: اِرْوِ حِكايَةَ جُحا وَالحِمارِ الضّائِعِ.
dialogue.tr: irwi ḥikāyata juḥā wa-l-ḥimāri ḍ-ḍāʾiʿ.
dialogue.en: Tell the story of Juha and the lost donkey.
dialogue.ur: Juha aur khoye hue gadhe ki kahani sunayen.

q.ur: «ثَقافَةٌ» ka matlab kya hai?
«حَقيقِيَّةٌ» ka ulta kya hai?
«زَميلٌ» ka matlab kya hai?
«نَوادِرُ وَطُرَفٌ» kya hain?
«Story» ko Arabi mein kya kehte hain?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني ما يُرْوى مِنْ أَحْداثٍ وَأَخْبارٍ؟

title.en: Spelling: Hamza at the end of a word
title.ur: Imla: Lafz ke aakhir ki hamza

intro.en: When hamza comes at the end of a word, how it is written depends on the vowel before it: after kasra it sits on ya (ئ), after damma on waw (ؤ), after fatha on alif (أ), and after a sukun it stands alone (ء).
intro.ur: Jab hamza lafz ke aakhir mein aati hai to uska likhna us se pehle wali harkat par hota hai: kasra ke baad ya par (ئ), damma ke baad waw par (ؤ), fatha ke baad alif par (أ), aur sukun ke baad akeli (ء).
intro.ar: عِنْدَما تَأْتي الهَمْزَةُ في آخِرِ الكَلِمَةِ تَعْتَمِدُ كِتابَتُها عَلى الحَرَكَةِ قَبْلَها: بَعْدَ الكَسْرَةِ عَلى ياءٍ (ئ)، وَبَعْدَ الضَّمَّةِ عَلى واوٍ (ؤ)، وَبَعْدَ الفَتْحَةِ عَلى أَلِفٍ (أ)، وَبَعْدَ السُّكونِ تُكْتَبُ وَحْدَها (ء).

dialogue.ar: بَعْدَ الكَسْرَةِ: ئ — هادِئ، قارِئ، دافِئ، مُبْتَدِئ
dialogue.tr: baʿda l-kasrati:  — hādiʾ, qāriʾ, dāfiʾ, mubtadiʾ
dialogue.en: After kasra: ئ — calm, reader, warm, beginner
dialogue.ur: Kasra ke baad: ئ — pursukoon, parhne wala, garam, mubtadi

dialogue.ar: بَعْدَ الضَّمَّةِ: ؤ — تَكافُؤ، يَجْرُؤ، تَوَضُّؤ، التَّباطُؤ
dialogue.tr: baʿda ḍ-ḍammati:  — takāfuʾ, yajruʾ, tawaḍḍuʾ, at-tabāṭuʾ
dialogue.en: After damma: ؤ — equality, he dares, ablution, slowness
dialogue.ur: Damma ke baad: ؤ — barabari, himmat karta hai, wuzu, susti

dialogue.ar: بَعْدَ الفَتْحَةِ: أ — هَدَأَ، نَشَأَ، قَرَأَ، بَدَأَ
dialogue.tr: baʿda l-fatḥati:  — hadaʾ, nashaʾ, qaraʾ, badaʾ
dialogue.en: After fatha: أ — he calmed, he grew up, he read, he began
dialogue.ur: Fatha ke baad: أ — woh pursukoon hua, pala barha, us ne parha, us ne shuru kiya

dialogue.ar: بَعْدَ السُّكونِ: ء — شَيْء، دِفْء، عِبْء، بُطْء
dialogue.tr: baʿda s-sukūn:  — shayʾ, difʾ, ʿibʾ, buṭʾ
dialogue.en: After sukun: ء — thing, warmth, burden, slowness
dialogue.ur: Sukun ke baad: ء — cheez, garmahat, bojh, aahistagi

q.en: Hamza after kasra is written on:
q.ur: Kasra ke baad hamza kis par likhi jati hai?

q.en: Hamza after damma is written on:
q.ur: Damma ke baad hamza kis par likhi jati hai?

q.en: Which word has hamza on alif?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein hamza alif par hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ فيها هَمْزَةٌ عَلى أَلِفٍ؟

q.en: In «جُزْء» the hamza stands alone because it comes after:
q.ur: «جُزْء» mein hamza akeli kyun hai? Kyunke us se pehle:
q.ar: في «جُزْء» تُكْتَبُ الهَمْزَةُ وَحْدَها لِأَنَّها جاءَتْ بَعْدَ:

q.ur: «لُؤْلُؤٌ» ka matlab kya hai?

options_ar: حَجَرٌ كَريمٌ أَبْيَضُ يُخْرَجُ مِنَ المَحارِ

intro.en: Tawkid is emphasis. Verbal emphasis repeats the same word: «اِصْبِرْ اِصْبِرْ». Meaning emphasis uses words like نَفْسُهُ, عَيْنُهُ, كُلُّهُ, كِلاهُما, كِلْتاهُما. Example: «جاءَ المُديرُ نَفْسُهُ».
intro.ur: Tawkid yani zor dena. Tawkid-e-lafzi mein wohi lafz dohraya jata hai: «اِصْبِرْ اِصْبِرْ». Tawkid-e-manawi mein نَفْسُهُ، عَيْنُهُ، كُلُّهُ، كِلاهُما، كِلْتاهُما jaise alfaz aate hain. Misal: «جاءَ المُديرُ نَفْسُهُ».
intro.ar: التَّوْكيدُ هُوَ تَقْوِيَةُ المَعْنى. التَّوْكيدُ اللَّفْظِيُّ يُكَرِّرُ الكَلِمَةَ نَفْسَها: «اِصْبِرْ اِصْبِرْ». وَالتَّوْكيدُ المَعْنَوِيُّ يَسْتَعْمِلُ كَلِماتٍ مِثْلَ نَفْسُهُ وَعَيْنُهُ وَكُلُّهُ وَكِلاهُما وَكِلْتاهُما. مِثالٌ: «جاءَ المُديرُ نَفْسُهُ».

dialogue.ar: جاءَ المُديرُ نَفْسُهُ إِلى الحَفْلِ.
dialogue.tr: jāʾa l-mudīru nafsuhu ilā l-ḥafl.
dialogue.en: The manager himself came to the party.
dialogue.ur: Manager khud taqreeb mein aaya.

dialogue.ar: قَرَأَ الطّالِبُ الكِتابَ كُلَّهُ.
dialogue.tr: qaraʾa ṭ-ṭālibu l-kitāba kullah.
dialogue.en: The student read the whole book.
dialogue.ur: Talib-e-ilm ne poori kitab parh li.

dialogue.ar: حَضَرَ الضُّيوفُ أَجْمَعونَ.
dialogue.tr: ḥaḍara ḍ-ḍīūfu ajmaʿūn.
dialogue.en: The guests all attended.
dialogue.ur: Tamam mehman hazir hue.

dialogue.ar: زُرْتُ كِلا الصَّديقَيْنِ، وَسَلَّمَتْ عَلَيَّ كِلْتا الأُخْتَيْنِ.
dialogue.tr: zurtu kilā ṣ-ṣadīqayn, wasallamat ʿalayya kiltā l-ʾukhtayn.
dialogue.en: I visited both friends, and both sisters greeted me.
dialogue.ur: Maine dono doston se mulaqat ki aur dono behnon ne mujhe salam kiya.

dialogue.ar: اِصْبِرْ اِصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ الفَرَجَ قَريبٌ.
dialogue.tr: iṣbir iṣbir faʾinna l-faraja qarībun.
dialogue.en: Be patient, be patient, for relief is near.
dialogue.ur: Sabr karo, sabr karo, ke aasani qareeb hai.

q.ur: «تَوْكيد» kya hai?

q.en: Which is verbal emphasis (repeating the same word)?
q.ur: Tawkid-e-lafzi (wohi lafz dohrana) kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ الأَمْثِلَةِ تَوْكيدٌ لَفْظِيٌّ (تَكْرارُ الكَلِمَةِ نَفْسِها)؟

q.ur: «كِلْتا» kis ke liye aata hai?

q.en: In «جاءَ المُديرُ نَفْسُهُ» the emphasis word is:
q.ur: «جاءَ المُديرُ نَفْسُهُ» mein tawkid ka lafz kaun sa hai?
q.ar: في «جاءَ المُديرُ نَفْسُهُ» ما كَلِمَةُ التَّوْكيدِ؟

q.ur: «كِلا» ka matlab kya hai?

intro.en: This is a review test with hadiths, a reading text about the Sunnah, vocabulary and grammar. Read the texts, then answer the questions. The reading says the Sunnah is the second source of Islam after the Qur'an.
intro.ur: Yeh dohrai ka imtihan hai jis mein ahadees, Sunnat ke baare mein ek tehreer, alfaz aur qawaid hain. Matan parhein phir sawalat ke jawab dein. Matan batata hai ke Sunnat Quran ke baad Islam ka doosra masdar hai.
intro.ar: هذا اخْتِبارُ مُراجَعَةٍ فيهِ أَحاديثُ، وَنَصٌّ عَنِ السُّنَّةِ، وَمُفْرَداتٌ وَقَواعِدُ. اِقْرَأِ النُّصوصَ ثُمَّ أَجِبْ. يَذْكُرُ النَّصُّ أَنَّ السُّنَّةَ هِيَ المَصْدَرُ الثّاني لِلْإِسْلامِ بَعْدَ القُرْآنِ.

dialogue.ar: قالَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ: «الجَنَّةُ تَحْتَ أَقْدامِ الأُمَّهاتِ».
dialogue.tr: qāla r-rasūlu ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam: al-jannatu taḥta aqdāmi l-ummahāt
dialogue.en: The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: Paradise lies at the feet of mothers.
dialogue.ur: Rasool ﷺ ne farmaya: Jannat maaon ke qadmon ke neeche hai.

dialogue.ar: قالَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ: «تَنَزَّهوا مِنَ البَوْلِ؛ فَإِنَّ عامَّةَ عَذابِ القَبْرِ مِنْهُ».
dialogue.tr: qāla r-rasūl: tanazzahū mina l-bawl; fa-inna ʿāmmata ʿadhābi l-qabri minh
dialogue.en: The Messenger said: Keep clean from urine, for most of the punishment of the grave is from it.
dialogue.ur: Rasool ﷺ ne farmaya: Peshab se bacho, kyunke qabr ke azab ka ziyada hissa usi se hai.

dialogue.ar: اِعْتَنى المُسْلِمونَ بِحِفْظِ الحَديثِ النَّبَوِيِّ وَنَقْلِهِ بِأَمانَةٍ وَدِقَّةٍ.
dialogue.tr: iʿtanā l-muslimūna biḥifẓi l-ḥadīthi n-nabawiyyi wanaqlihi biʾamānatin wadiqqatin.
dialogue.en: Muslims took care to preserve the Prophet's hadith and transmit it with trust and precision.
dialogue.ur: Musalmanon ne Nabi ﷺ ki hadith ko mehfooz karne aur amanat o durustgi se aage pohanchane ka ehtimam kiya.

dialogue.ar: وَالسُّنَّةُ تُبَيِّنُ القُرْآنَ وَتَشْرَحُهُ، فَهِيَ المَصْدَرُ الثّاني لِلإِسْلامِ بَعْدَهُ.
dialogue.tr: wa-s-sunnatu tubayyinu l-qurʾāna watashraḥuh, fahiya l-maṣdaru th-thānī lilʾislāmi baʿdah.
dialogue.en: The Sunnah explains the Qur'an and clarifies it; it is the second source of Islam after it.
dialogue.ur: Sunnat Quran ki wazahat aur tashreeh karti hai, is liye woh Quran ke baad Islam ka doosra masdar hai.

dialogue.ar: حَفِظَ الصَّحابَةُ عَنْ نَبِيِّهِمْ ﷺ أَقْوالَهُ وَأَفْعالَهُ وَما أَقَرَّهُ مِنْ أَحْوالِ النّاسِ.
dialogue.tr: ḥafiẓa ṣ-ṣaḥābatu ʿan nabiyyihim ﷺ aqūālahu waʾafʿālahu wamā aqarrahu min aḥūāli n-nās.
dialogue.en: The Companions memorised from their Prophet ﷺ his sayings, his actions and what he approved of among people's conduct.
dialogue.ur: Sahaba ne apne Nabi ﷺ ke aqwal, af'al aur woh baatein yaad rakhin jin ko aap ne manzoor farmaya.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ دَقَّقَ العُلَماءُ في الإِسْنادِ، فَسَأَلوا عَنْ حالِ كُلِّ راوٍ لِيَطْمَئِنّوا إِلى صِحَّةِ الحَديثِ.
dialogue.tr: waqad daqqaqa l-ʿulamāʾu fī l-ʾisnād, fasaʾalū ʿan ḥāli kulli rāwin liyaṭmaʾinnū ilā ṣiḥḥati l-ḥadīth.
dialogue.en: Scholars examined the chain of narration closely and asked about the state of every narrator to be sure the hadith was sound.
dialogue.ur: Ulama ne isnad ko bareeki se parkha aur har rawi ke haal ke baare mein poocha taake hadith ki sehat par mutmain hon.

q.en: According to the hadith, Paradise lies:
q.ur: Hadees ke mutabiq jannat kahan hai?

q.en: The reading says the second source of Islam is:
q.ur: Matan ke mutabiq Islam ka doosra masdar hai:
q.ar: يَذْكُرُ النَّصُّ أَنَّ المَصْدَرَ الثّانِيَ لِلْإِسْلامِ هُوَ:

q.ur: «الإِسْنادُ» ka matlab kya hai?
Sahaba Nabi ﷺ ke kya yaad rakhte the?
«الصَّحابَةُ» ka matlab kya hai?
